verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows synchronous search/extract/crawl/map/research calls plus per-minute rate limits (100/1,000 RPM) and 429 retry-after handling—no batch submission endpoint, job queue, or async job-status API is documented anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: batch job submission endpoint, async job ID/polling or webhook completion mechanism, bulk-query pricing tier for high-volume async workloads.
